shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in a navy cardigan sits in the shelf-side window seat and tells an anecdote, while a man in a mustard sweater occupies the doorway-side window seat, a woman in a emerald blouse occupies the shelf-side aisle seat, and a man in a burgundy hoodie occupies the doorway-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in a mustard sweater asks the woman in a navy cardigan for details.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a navy cardigan concludes the anecdote for the man in a mustard sweater and the woman in a emerald blouse.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the game table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
